name: UP TGT/PGT School Teacher Mock Test - Practice Test 2
courseName: UP TGT/PGT School Teacher Mock Test

questions.question: According to Piaget's stages of cognitive development, the stage of formal operations begins at age:
questions.hint: Formal operational stage starts around age 11/12 and involves abstract logic thinking.

questions.question: What is the full form of NCERT?
options: National Council of Educational Research and Training
National Committee of Education, Research and Teaching
National Council of Elementary Research and Training
questions.hint: NCERT is an autonomous organisation advising the central and state governments on school education.

questions.question: Which teaching method is most suitable for developing creative thinking?
questions.hint: Brainstorming encourages pupils to generate diverse ideas without premature criticism.

questions.question: The term Pedagogy refers to:
questions.hint: Pedagogy covers the methods, theories, and instructional design used in education.

questions.question: Diagnostic evaluation in classroom teaching is used to:
options: Assign grades at the end of term
questions.hint: Diagnostic tests check prior gaps and pinpoint specific concept difficulties.

questions.question: Who is known as the father of modern behaviorism?
questions.hint: Watson published behaviorist principles first, advocating objective observations of actions.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of homework given to school students?
questions.hint: Homework consolidates the skills introduced during direct class instructions.

questions.question: Micro-teaching is used by teachers to practice:
questions.hint: Micro-teaching scales down class size and time to master specific instructional methods.

questions.question: According to NEP 2020, the current 10+2 system is replaced by:
questions.hint: NEP replaces 10+2 with Foundational (5), Preparatory (3), Middle (3), and Secondary (4) stages.

questions.question: Cognitive domain in Bloom's Taxonomy deals with:
questions.hint: Cognitive covers memory, comprehension, application, analysis, synthesis, and evaluation.

questions.question: The teacher is considered a:
questions.hint: Modern child-centric education positions the teacher as a guide/facilitator.

questions.question: Inclusive education means:
options: Providing equal learning opportunities to all children
questions.hint: Inclusive classes integrate special needs kids in general educational classrooms.

questions.question: Educational psychology is the study of:
options: How people learn in educational settings
questions.hint: It focuses on student development, learning theories, motivation, and instruction.

questions.question: Which agency is responsible for curriculum design for school education in India?
questions.hint: NCERT frames the National Curriculum Framework (NCF) for school boards.

questions.question: What is the main objective of formative assessment?
options: Monitor student learning to provide ongoing feedback
questions.hint: Formative assessments occur mid-course to identify gaps and adjust active learning.
